trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed health checks in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The SEV2 for checkout-api says what failed, which regions were affected and what was rolled back. It also lists next steps: keep watching health and find the cause in v2.3.1 before it goes out again. A human operator confirmed the incident was created and the on-call engineer has been paged.
